subject.title: Feature Request: cron.defaults.delivery config for default delivery target

question: Should OpenClaw add a global cron recipient default, and if so should it be materialized into new jobs at creation time rather than inherited dynamically at every run?
rationale: Both approaches reduce repetitive configuration, but runtime inheritance can silently retarget existing scheduled output after a config edit, while creation-time materialization is safer but does not centrally retarget an existing fleet.

options.title: Materialize On Creation
options.body: Apply configured channel, target, account, and thread fields only while creating jobs that omit them, then store the resolved delivery explicitly so later config edits cannot silently reroute existing jobs.

options.title: Dynamic Runtime Inheritance
options.body: Resolve missing delivery fields from current config at every run, accepting that a global config edit can immediately retarget existing scheduled output.

options.title: Keep Explicit Delivery
options.body: Do not add another config surface; instead improve CLI and Control UI templates, route previews, and warnings so users choose a deterministic target for each job.

recommendation.title: Materialize On Creation
recommendation.body: Apply configured channel, target, account, and thread fields only while creating jobs that omit them, then store the resolved delivery explicitly so later config edits cannot silently reroute existing jobs.

likelyOwner.reason: Cron runtime and delivery behavior fall directly within the documented cron ownership area, with @joshavant as the adjacent security/config reviewer.
